notes.title: 🔥Are You Ready to Fly, Heroes?
notes.content:
[p]Hello firefighters!
This update completely overhauls the game's structure to offer a [b]more fun and easier experience[/b].[/p][p]🚀 [b]You can now truly fly!
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417399/df30744fd166719f3dd159082dcc7e7fe9a3e461.gif"][/img]
Previously, your water weapon only allowed brief lifts, and your water tank had limited capacity. Now, both your [b]flight duration[/b] and [b]tank capacity[/b] have been increased! But be careful—
[b]Water is stronger now.[/b] You might accidentally knock your friends off platforms while spraying water! (Or maybe [i]not[/i] accidentally... 👀)[/p][p]📍 [b]Map improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]City[/b] map has been rebalanced. Less rage, more fun![/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Hell[/b] map has fewer obstacles now. Rescuing the red cat should be easier.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Wall[/b] map has improved gameplay for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]I hope you enjoy the game even more with this update.
Thanks for saving the cats they truly appreciate it! 😺
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417399/5716703ed979b8ba79fc21fd96babd10d9dc1f59.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Game is Out... Kittens Are Waiting to Be Rescued!
notes.content:
[b]The game is finally out 🥳🥳
Launched with a 15% discount!
Let me tell you what's in the game:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417399/1f46c506314360701259d6add0ec6df028b10f6a.png[/img]

There are 2 game modes. In the "Normal" game mode, there are 6 different maps, each with unique mechanics to test your firefighter skills 🔥
This mode has two difficulty levels: in Normal, you have infinite respawns. In Hard mode, you can only respawn 3 times. Hard mode also includes a leaderboard—will your name be at the top among firefighters?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417399/9981105975a825b58709cf45f3259851b56fa784.png[/img]

In Party mode, there are 5 mini-games. You'll play 3 random ones each time and compete with your friends. Let's see who among you is the best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417399/8678750a4f240095fe724257df3bf22bf8db2dcb.jpg[/img]

I plan to add extra customization options in the future, but I believe you can already reflect your own style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417399/a4c501119eafc1818d3c96c910a2d465d8ba7dc6.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy the game.
Happy rescuing 🐈

notes.title: 800 Brave Firefighters!
notes.content:
Hello, firefighters! During the Steam Next Fest, 2500 firefighters joined our ranks.
Among them, 800 brave firefighters took part in the rescue operation to save the kitten on the City Map!

Additionally, our demo has reached 11 positive reviews and is now marked as "Positive."

Thank you all for giving Firefighters Together a chance!

Other kittens are still waiting to be rescued...

See you soon!

notes.title: Demo Update | No More Drifting
notes.content:
Hello, firefighters! Based on your feedback, I have stopped the character from drifting.
With this update, I hope you will have a smoother gameplay experience.
Have fun!

notes.title: DEMO ALERT 🚨
notes.content:
🚒 Hey, firefighters!

The Firefighters Together demo is now live! 🥳 Your first mission is to rescue the stranded kitty in the "City" map. But be careful—the fire is spreading everywhere!

You can face this challenge alone or team up with your friends to save the city together. Work together, put out the fires, and bring the poor kitty to safety! 🚒💨

🔥 Features:
✅ Chaotic and fun co-op gameplay
✅ Different types of fires and challenging obstacles
✅ Interactive environment with fun physics
✅ Unforgettable moments with your friends!

Download now, gather your team, and complete your first rescue mission! 🏆

Don't forget to share your feedback with us! 📝 You can reach us on Discord and social media. 🎤

Are you ready? Then grab your water gun and jump into the fire!

👇👇👇👇👇
